name.text: Finding the value of unknown angle using trigonometric ratio.

questiontext.text:
Use trigonometric ratios to find the value of the marked angles in the following triangles.

Note: Write your answers correct to 2 decimal places.

(a)

[[jsxgraph]] var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(BOARDID, { boundingbox: [-1, 4.5, 5, -1.5], keepAspectRatio: true, showNavigation: false, showCopyright: false }); function getRandomColor() { var letters = '0123456789ABCDEF'; var color = '#'; for (var i = 0; i < 6; i++) { color += letters[Math.floor(Math.random() * 16)]; } return color; } var triangleColor = getRandomColor(); var A = board.create('point', [0, 0], {name: "A", visible: false}); var B = board.create('point', [4, 0], {name: "B", visible: false}); var C = board.create('point', [0, 3], {name: "C", visible: false}); var triangle = board.create('polygon', [A, B, C], {fillColor: triangleColor, fillOpacity: 0.6}); var rightAngle = board.create('angle', [B, A, C], {radius: 0.4, type: 'square', strokeColor: 'black', name: ""}); var alpha = board.create('angle', [C, B, A], {radius: 0.5, strokeColor: 'black', name: "{#val_letter1#}°"}); triangle.borders.forEach(function(border) { border.setAttribute({strokeColor: 'black'}); }); board.create('text', [2, -0.5, "{#adj1#}"]); board.create('text', [2.2, 1.8, "{#hyp1#}"]); [[/jsxgraph]]

Angle \({@val_letter1@} =\) [[input:ans1]] ° [[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]]

(b)

(c)

[[jsxgraph]] var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(BOARDID, { boundingbox: [-5, 1.5, 1, -4.5], keepAspectRatio: true, showNavigation: false, showCopyright: false }); function getRandomColor() { var letters = '0123456789ABCDEF'; var color = '#'; for (var i = 0; i < 6; i++) { color += letters[Math.floor(Math.random() * 16)]; } return color; } var triangleColor = getRandomColor(); /* Built rotated naturally to keep labels attached */ var A = board.create('point', [0, 0], {name: "A", visible: false}); var B = board.create('point', [-4, 0], {name: "B", visible: false}); var C = board.create('point', [0, -3], {name: "C", visible: false}); var triangle = board.create('polygon', [A, B, C], {fillColor: triangleColor, fillOpacity: 0.6}); var rightAngle = board.create('angle', [B, A, C], {radius: 0.4, type: 'square', strokeColor: 'black', name: ""}); var theta = board.create('angle', [B, C, A], {radius: 0.5, strokeColor: 'black', name: "{#val_letter3#}°"}); triangle.borders.forEach(function(border) { border.setAttribute({strokeColor: 'black'}); }); board.create('text', [-2, 0.5, "{#adj3#}"]); board.create('text', [0.5, -1.5, "{#opp3#}"]); [[/jsxgraph]]

falsefeedback.text: You identified the triangle correctly, but you used the wrong trigonometric ratio. Remember, cosine compares the adjacent side to the hypotenuse side, not the sine or tangent ratios. Check which sides are adjacent and opposite to the given angle, and try again using the correct ratio.
